story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain on the measured clock, not observed. The camera's display pans the dry land through a full turn and a wisp rises in it, then the picture pulls back to the whole tower. Sixteen of 56 lens rings light and 16 installed stamps, then 56 planned by February 2027 pins. The display swings onto the smoke and the flag box locks. The alert card leaves the display for the crew truck, comes in at the cab windshield and lands on the dash phone. The dash clock marks an estimated window of up to ten minutes. The plume keeps burning under Doesn't prevent fires. Wide, a heavier dashed line from the truck stops clearly short of the responder badge as Can share pins below. A visor calendar since launch shows no red mark and is attributed to AEP's wildfire lead. A blank Response record slides onto the tailgate with its empty fields pulsing. The filed plan folder arrives with its State approval slot open and Expected January 2027 pins, and the composite closes the film.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the tower camera sees and ends with the alert landed at the crew, the line toward responders open, no response record and the plan awaiting state approval.
story_review.weakest_transition: s4-shot-2 to s5-shot-1 (22.78 s): from the dash clock in the cab straight back inside the lens display with no physical bridge.
